translation.spanish: Has creado a todos los seres y sostienes al mundo en Tus Manos, ¿Qué grandeza hay en poner un anillo en la nariz de la cobra negra como hizo Krishna?

devanagari.text: जीअ उपाइ जुगति हथि कीनी काली नथि किआ वडा भइआ ॥

english.default: Whose Husband are You? Who is Your wife? You are subtly diffused and pervading in all. ||2||

english.default: Brahma, the bestower of blessings, entered the stem of the lotus, with his relatives, to find the extent of the universe.

english.default: Proceeding on, he could not find its limits; what glory was obtained by killing Kansa, the king? ||3||
